text: Webhooks send real-time notifications when certain events happen in your account; you register an endpoint and pick which events to receive
quote: Brex APIs offer webhooks to notify you in real-time when certain events happen in your account.

text: An endpoint returns webhook signing secrets used to validate incoming webhooks
quote: This endpoint returns a set of webhook signing secrets used to validate the webhook.

text: Subscribe to pending transaction events for Brex Card expenses
quote: Subscribe to receive pending transaction events for expenses made on Brex Card

text: Receive a webhook when a referral you made has activated
quote: you can receive a webhook when a referral you made has activated

text: Admins create named API tokens in the dashboard and choose data-access scopes for each token
quote: Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin... Click Create Token. Create a name for your token... Choose what level of data access you need for your application; these are the scopes

text: Call Brex APIs by generating a user token in the dashboard and passing it in API request headers
quote: To start making calls to Brex APIs, generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers.

text: Official MCP server lets AI assistants manage expenses, users, cards, banking transactions and bills through natural language
quote: The Brex MCP server lets AI assistants interact directly with your Brex account: manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review banking transactions, track bills, and more through natural language.

text: The MCP server can be added to Claude over HTTP transport at api.brex.com/mcp
quote: claude mcp add --transport http brex https://api.brex.com/mcp

text: Transactions API exposes transactions, accounts, and statements
quote: The transactions API lets you view your transactions, accounts, and statements.

text: API endpoint lists all settled transactions across all card accounts
quote: This endpoint lists all settled transactions for all card accounts.

text: Budgets API manages Brex Budgets and Spend Limits
quote: The budgets API lets you manage your Brex Budgets and Spend Limits.

text: Travel booking objects show whether a booking was out of policy and which travel policy rules it violated
quote: Added `policy` to booking objects, exposing whether a booking was out of policy and which travel policy rules it violated.

text: Receipts can be uploaded through a pre-signed S3 URL and are automatically matched to existing expenses
quote: The uri will be a pre-signed S3 URL allowing you to upload the receipt securely... we will try to match the receipt with existing expenses.

text: Set rules for spending, required documentation, and approvers; Brex AI applies them to every transaction
quote: Set rules for how employees can spend, what they need to document, and who needs to approve. Brex AI applies them to every transaction.

text: Create auto-enforced spend limits for stipends, travel, procurement, and more
quote: Create limits for stipends, travel, procurement, and more. Auto-enforced controls empower employees to spend with confidence.

text: Assign top-line budgets and track spend against them instantly
quote: Assign top-line budgets, and track spend instantly, ensuring every dollar is allocated where it has the biggest impact.

text: Multi-level approval flows based on amount, vendor, employee role and more, with automatic routing
quote: Tailor multi-level approval flows based on amount, vendor, employee role, and more — and Brex will route for you automatically to ensure the right people sign off every time.

text: Brex emails vendors a secure link where they upload their own payment details
quote: Enter your vendor's email address and Brex will send a secure link where they can upload their payment details.

text: AI captures itemized invoice details, suggests the matching PO, and drafts a payment
quote: Brex AI will capture every itemized detail, suggest the matching PO, and draft a payment.

text: Pay bills with an instantly created virtual card, or send ACH, checks, and wires from any bank or Brex business account
quote: Create a virtual card instantly to pay by card and earn rewards. Send ACH, checks, and wires from any bank account or a Brex business account for even faster payments in more currencies.

text: An audit agent monitors expenses against internal processes and categorizes potential violations by risk level
quote: Your audit agent monitors company expenses according to your internal processes and categorizes potential violations by risk level.

text: A review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses, escalates exceptions, and follows up with anyone out of compliance
quote: Your review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses and requests, escalates exceptions, and follows up with anyone out of compliance.

text: AI agents categorize, review, and approve spend instantly based on company policies
quote: Stop waiting for people to categorize, review, or approve spend. Let AI agents do it instantly, based on your policies and with total transparency.

text: AI assistants handle employees' expenses: writing memos, fetching receipts, giving policy help, and filing reimbursements automatically
quote: AI assistants do employees' expenses for them, writing memos, fetching receipts, offering policy help, even filing reimbursements automatically.

text: Prepared expense data syncs automatically to Puzzle accounting with no manual setup or matching
quote: Prepared expense data sync automatically to eliminate manual set up or matching between Brex and Puzzle.

text: Treasury product that earns yield
quote: Get global card and a treasury product that earns yield†, plus modern accounting from Puzzle.

text: List users API supports filters by name, email, status, manager, department, location, title, cost center, legal entity, and custom fields
quote: Added filter query parameters to List users: `name`, `email[]`, `status[]`, `manager_id[]`, `department_id[]`, `location_id[]`, `title_id[]`, `cost_center_id[]`, `legal_entity_id[]`, and `custom_field[]`.

text: Physical and virtual Mastercard cards accepted in 210+ countries and territories
quote: Physical and virtual cards issued on the leading worldwide network, Mastercard, with acceptance in 210+ countries and territories.

text: Spin up virtual cards in one click
quote: Eliminate data entry, automate approvals, and spin up virtual cards in one click to maximize your rewards.

text: Mobile app supports Apple Pay, cancelling a card, and viewing spend
quote: Manage your card from your phone. Pay with Apple Pay, cancel your card, and view your spend all in one app.

text: Card limit adjusts to the business based on financial factors such as revenue or dollars raised
quote: Get a card limit that keeps pace with your business based on financial factors such as revenue or dollars raised.

text: Referrals API creates referrals with a personalized application link and can prefill the applicant's information
quote: submit customer referrals to Brex and receive a customized Brex application URL. You can optionally submit additional information to help prefill their application

text: Zapier integration creates customized, prefilled Brex applications for clients
quote: Zapier will allow you to create customized, prefilled Brex applications for your clients.

text: Brex developer workspace provides forkable collections for all Brex APIs
quote: go to the Brex developer workspace which has collections for all of the Brex APIs. You can fork the collection into your own workspace

text: Bulk create employee virtual cards by emailing a CSV to a Pipedream workflow
quote: creating a CSV with the cards you need to bulk create, and then emailing tha CSV to Pipedream to automatically bulk create the cards.

text: Workato integration supports bulk user creation, monthly user limits, virtual card issuance, and vendor payments
quote: Workato...to enable various use cases including bulk creating users, setting monthly limits for users, issuing virtual cards, and sending vendor payments

text: Recipe exports Brex card transactions monthly to a CSV in Google Drive
quote: Monthly Export of Brex Card Transactions to CSV in Google Drive

text: Payments API manages vendors and sends ACH, domestic wires, and checks from Brex business accounts
quote: Payments API: Manage vendors and send ACH, domestic wires, and checks

text: Transfer objects in the Payments API include IMAD and OMAD wire identifiers
quote: Payments API: Added `imad` and `omad` to transfer objects returned by List transfers, Get transfer, and Create transfer.

text: Out-of-policy purchases are blocked automatically using preset rules and limits
quote: Automatically block out-of-policy purchases, with preset rules and limits.

text: Close the books in real time by automating manual expense work
quote: Manage global spend and close the books in real time — with unmatched automation of manual expense work.

text: Travel booking with global inventory and auto-enforced expense policies on one platform
quote: Simplify travel with global inventory and auto-enforced expense policies on one platform.

text: Set up the accounting system integration in one click
quote: Set up your accounting system in one click.

text: Accounting API manages accounting data for connecting to your accounting system
quote: The Accounting API allows you to manage accounting data for connecting to your accounting system.

text: Team API can create an inactive employee without sending an invitation
quote: Team API: Added Create user (`POST /v2/users/create`) to create an inactive employee without sending an invitation.

text: Team API supports updating and deleting departments, locations, and titles
quote: Team API: Added update and delete endpoints for departments, locations, and titles.

text: Team API lists and retrieves cost centers, with dedicated read and read-write OAuth scopes
quote: Team API: Added List cost centers and Get cost center, including the `cost_centers` and `cost_centers.readonly` OAuth scopes.

text: Update user API can archive and restore inactive users and delete invited or inactive users
quote: Expanded the statuses accepted by Update user to support archiving and restoring inactive users and deleting invited or inactive users.

text: API lists travel trips using query-string filters
quote: Lists trips according to the filters passed in the query string.

text: Fields API manages custom fields, currently limited to single-select dropdowns
quote: The Fields API currently supports only single-select dropdown fields.

text: A TypeScript client library for the Brex API is available, built by third party Maroo
quote: TypeScript client library for Brex API developed by Maroo

text: A single user can hold multiple deposit accounts and cards
quote: Yes, a Brex user can have multiple deposit accounts and cards.

text: Approved API partners receive staging environment credentials
quote: Once your application is approved, you'll receive credentials for the staging environment using SendSafely.
